step1_analysis.description: This circuit acts as an RF power detector for a Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI). It uses unbalanced cross-coupled differential pairs to cancel the fundamental AC component and extract the second-order (squared) term, producing a DC current that decreases proportionally to the RF signal amplitude.

paper_reference.title: A 110-MHz 84-dB CMOS Programmable Gain Amplifier With Integrated RSSI Function

DC_Max_Current.description: Maximum DC output current at zero differential input (bell curve peak).

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming tail currents Iss=50uA and an unbalanced ratio K=4 (W_xm2=4*W_xm1). At DC, I_N1 = 2K/(K+1)*Iss = 80uA, I_N0 = 2/(K+1)*Iss = 20uA. I_XM5 = I_N1 - I_N0 = 60uA. Mirrored 1:1 to DELTA_I.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the chosen tail current and unbalance ratio K. Set to 60uA based on 50uA tails and K=4.

DC_Min_Current.description: Minimum DC output current at large differential input.

sky130_expected.calculation: At large differential input, one transistor in each pair takes all tail current. I_N1 = Iss = 50uA, I_N0 = Iss = 50uA. I_XM5 = max(0, I_N1 - I_N0) = 0uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected PMOS load clips any negative current difference to zero.

Transient_Avg_Current.description: Average DC output current under 110MHz RF excitation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 0.2V amplitude RF signal, the operating point moves down the sides of the inverted bell curve, reducing the average DC current from the 60uA peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The exact value depends on the RF amplitude. It must be strictly less than DC_Max_Current to indicate successful square-law detection.

Operating_Frequency.description: The target RF frequency for the detector.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's target IF/RF frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the DC transfer characteristic (inverted bell curve) and the transient average current under 110MHz RF excitation to verify RSSI square-law detection.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RSSI Detector Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Unbalanced pair parameters (K=4) for square-law detection
.param W_xm1=1u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=4u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=4u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=1u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_N4 N4 0 DC 0.9
V_VIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.2 110MEG 0 0)

* Tail currents for the differential pairs
I_N5 N5 0 50u
I_N3 N3 0 50u

* Output load to measure DELTA_I
V_MEAS DELTA_I 0 DC 0.9

* DUT
XM5 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM1 N0 VIN N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 N1 VIN N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2 N1 N4 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM6 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 DELTA_I N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.control
  * 1. DC Sweep for Bell Curve Characteristic
  dc V_VIN 0.4 1.4 0.01
  let out_i = abs(i(V_MEAS))
  meas dc i_max max out_i
  meas dc i_min min out_i
  
  * 2. Transient Analysis for RSSI Average Current
  tran 0.1n 50n
  let out_i_tran = abs(i(V_MEAS))
  meas tran i_avg avg out_i_tran from=20n to=50n
  
  print i_max i_min i_avg
.endc
.end
